entities.name: Cadafael Cadomedd ap Cynfeddw
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Cadafael was King of Gwynedd. He came to the throne when his predecessor, King Cadwallon ap Cadfan, was killed in battle, and his primary notability is in having gained the disrespectful sobriquet Cadafael Cadomedd.
